items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that tensoring with a K-flat complex preserves quasi-isomorphisms (statement lines 3010-3024). The proof is a two-input reduction: the cited same-chapter lemma turns K-flatness into exactness of the functor Tot(- tensor K^bullet), and the characterisation of quasi-isomorphisms by acyclicity of their cones turns exactness into preservation of quasi-isomorphisms (proof lines 3027-3030). The content is the pair of standard facts and the observation that the functor is compatible with cones. The claim is H2: one reduction, with both inputs named.
